diligence.summary: Sedemac Mechatronics is a technology-focused auto component manufacturer specializing in electronic control units and controllers for two-wheelers and off-road vehicles. While the company demonstrates strong growth and high ROCE, it faces scrutiny regarding tax litigation and rising working capital intensity.
diligence.management: The company is led by promoter Manish Sharma and a professional management team. It is backed by private equity firm Xponentia Capital, which has been trimming its stake post-listing. Management has maintained a clean record regarding share pledges, with formal disclosures confirming no encumbrances.
diligence.controversies: The company is currently contesting an Income Tax penalty of Rs 74.93 lakh related to FY 2017-18 R&D deductions. Additionally, it received a minor GST demand of Rs 40,036 in September 2026, though a much larger initial notice was dropped by authorities. No major auditor resignations or governance failures have been reported.
diligence.business_update: In Q4 FY26, the company reported significant capex of Rs 227 crore to support capacity expansion. Management emphasizes that as an auto-component supplier, they operate on a rolling supply basis rather than a traditional long-term order book model.
strengths: Strong ROCE of 31% indicating efficient capital utilization
Strong revenue CAGR of 36% over the last 3 years
risks: Negative free cash flow suggesting high capital intensity
Significant increase in receivable days (251% over 3 years) indicating potential collection issues
Ongoing tax litigation regarding R&D deductions
High valuation (PE 124) leaves little margin for error

exit_triggers: Promoter pledge appears or rises above 10%, or promoter holding falls more than 2 pp.
Operating cash flow stays below half of profit for two years running.
Weekly close below the 200-day average on rising volume.
Order book or order inflow stops growing faster than revenue at the next concall.
